title: 第六百九十六章 大本营第六百九十五章 欺人太甚
content_zh:
第六百九十六章大本营
而就在那一条真龙，隐隐约约之间，看起来非常自信的时候。
却见到。
那万寿山福地，正盘坐在人参果树下面窥探的这一方虚无世界的宋风，脸上似乎露出了几分了然:
“……原来这玩意儿就是灵宝？”
想到这里的时候，他则是微微伸手，隐约间似乎有一方大钟出现在他的手中。
但是演化了半天。
甚至，将能窥探到的消息全都结合在一起，也没有真正成功。
等到最后的时候，宋风直接就将那大钟收入手中，眼神之中露出来了几分思索之色:
“灵宝的概念，贫道似乎是有些明白了，但是若真的按照方向走的话，那可就有些了不得。”
“这近乎就是一个道果的映照，说起来的话，也足以算得上是另外一个道果存在。”
“如果贫道推演的灵宝没毛病的话，那妖龙就完全是在吹牛逼了，吓我一跳，贫道还以为自己要翻车了。”
虽然他现如今，面前那一幅世界虚影之中的画面，看起来好像是信号不好一样，时断时续。
甚至有时候，那妖龙都能隐藏身形。
根本搞不清这家伙在哪。
但是。
他也不是吃素的。
只是凭借着妖龙几次小小的破绽，他就悄无声息的，窥探了那妖龙的状态好几次。
虽然不能将其称为跨界宠物。
但也算得上是道友嘛。

而且他敢断定，这妖龙必定来历非凡，要不然的话，道果级别的东西哪能随意窥探。
他都已经半只脚走进去了，怎么可能不知道这一个境界的了得？
……
就在宋风跟着妖龙两个人互相斗智斗勇，你做我猜，各自施展手段的时候。
只见到。
已经跨界而来，来到高山村求真观的宋诚，则是将目光，看向了现如今在道观中修行的大徒弟。
时间一闪而逝。
面前这大徒弟，也不是自己刚刚收徒时候的那种青涩模样。
现如今身穿一身道袍。
整个人气质非凡。
已经是一个仙气飘飘的年轻道人了。
倒还真有了一点，求真观三代大师兄的意味。
不过。
如今这弟子已经顺理成章地修成了精满之路，但是偏偏缺了一口气息，使得气息并未大成。
精满气足，差了那一步。
“……师父，您回来了。”
王善一见到自家师父回来，脸上则是满是喜色。
content_en:
Chapter 696: Base Camp
And just when that real dragon seemed vaguely confident.
But I saw it.
In the blessed land of Wanshou Mountain, Song Feng, who was sitting under the ginseng fruit tree and peering into the void world, seemed to have a bit of understanding on his face:
"...So this thing is a spiritual treasure?"
When he thought of this, he stretched out his hand slightly, and a big clock seemed to appear in his hand.
But it took a long time to evolve.
Even combining all the information that could be spied on was not really successful.
At the end, Song Feng directly took the big clock into his hands, with a hint of thinking in his eyes:
"Pindao seems to have some understanding of the concept of Lingbao, but if he really follows the direction, it will be a big deal."
"This is almost the reflection of a Tao Fruit. Speaking of which, it can be regarded as the existence of another Tao Fruit."
"If there is nothing wrong with the spirit treasure deduced by Pindao, then the demon dragon is completely bragging. I was so shocked that Pindao thought he was about to overturn."
Although now, the picture in front of him in the virtual world seems to have poor signal, intermittent.
Even sometimes, the demonic dragon can hide its figure.
I have no idea where this guy is.
but.
He is not a vegetarian either.
Just relying on several small flaws of the demon dragon, he quietly spied on the status of the demon dragon several times.
Although you can't call it a crossover pet.
But he can still be regarded as a Taoist friend.
And he dared to conclude that this demon dragon must have an extraordinary origin. Otherwise, how could something at the Dao Fruit level be able to spy on it at will.
He has already walked in with half a foot, how could he not know how amazing this realm is?
…
Just when Song Feng and Yao Long were fighting each other with wits and courage, you and I made guesses and each used their own methods.
Only seen.
Song Cheng, who had crossed the border and came to Gaoshan Village to seek truth, turned his attention to the great disciple who was now practicing in the Taoist temple.
Time flies by.
The eldest disciple in front of him is not as young as he was when he first accepted him as his disciple.
Now he is wearing a Taoist robe.
The whole person has an extraordinary temperament.
He is already a young Taoist with an air of immortality.
It actually has a bit of a meaning of seeking truth and observing the third generation senior brother.
but.
Now this disciple has successfully cultivated the path to perfection, but he is missing a breath, so the breath has not been fully achieved.
I am full of energy, but I am missing that step.
"...Master, you are back."
When Wang Shan saw his master coming back, his face was filled with joy.
